selection.rule: First N pairs sorted lexicographically by the original test hazy ZIP member name; selected before model inference

protocol.scope: All paired images in the source release's held-out test split, using the common resized local protocol; not a reproduction of paper-table scores
protocol.color_space: RGB, all three channels; no Y conversion, histogram matching, or post-hoc alignment
protocol.preprocessing: Input and reference must have identical original dimensions. Downsample both once with PIL BICUBIC to the same aspect-preserving size, max side 512 by default, round(W*scale), round(H*scale), minimum 1; never upscale or crop.
protocol.model_input: The same prepared RGB uint8 input is passed to every model with max_side=None. The model wrapper reflect-pads bottom/right to multiples of 64, then removes that padding. No geometric crop remains in metrics.
protocol.psnr: skimage PSNR on RGB float64 uint8/255, data_range=1, full image, no border shave
protocol.ssim: skimage RGB SSIM, channel_axis=-1, data_range=1, gaussian_weights=True, sigma=1.5, win_size=11, use_sample_covariance=False; requires both axes >=11. Standard skimage SSIM averages the valid interior of the Gaussian window.
protocol.mae: Mean absolute RGB error on float64 uint8/255; range [0,1]
protocol.output_quantization: Metrics use the same clipped, rounded uint8 RGB model output that is saved and displayed in the UI
protocol.aggregation: Equal-weight arithmetic mean of per-image PSNR, SSIM, and MAE; no pooled-MSE PSNR
protocol.randomness: Same explicit seed for every call. Repeated runs measure timing; the first result is the quality output. Output SHA-256 is recorded and repeated-output equality is checked.
protocol.timing: Per-image median of --runs complete forward GPU timings (manager gpu_ms); loading, warmup, transfers and image IO are excluded from gpu_ms. Wall elapsed_ms, loading and warmup remain separately recorded. Sequential batch 1; the manager holds one model at a time.
protocol.precision: Released inference configuration per model: PGL-Net-T and HNDiff-FocalNet FP32, PixRestore-S BF16 autocast when supported. This is a deployment comparison, not a controlled equal-precision architecture experiment.
protocol.weights: PGL-Net-T and HNDiff use RW2AH-specific released weights; PixRestore-S uses the released general restoration checkpoint. Training data/compute are not equalized.
protocol.limitations: All source-release test pairs are included. Resizing can change apparent haze/noise and absolute scores. Released models have different training data, inference precision and wrappers. Do not claim a global SOTA ranking or robot-task gains from this experiment. No paper-table values are mixed with local metrics.
protocol.nonfinite_json: Perfect-match PSNR is +infinity in compute_metrics; strict JSON exports null for nonfinite numbers and preserves perfect_match=true. CSV writes inf.
